source_snapshot.items: All SAS/SATA NVMe LED Check - Raid fail
source_snapshot.procedure: Create NVMe RAID1, unplug one NVMe member and inspect the RAID-fail LED.
source_snapshot.criteria: LED behavior matches the system specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL substitutes Locate/raw IPMI indicator control for a real degraded array.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires disposable members, stable mapping, real RAID1 degraded-state proof, physical evidence and separately approved recovery.

old_problem: SAS/SATA taxonomy conflicts with an explicit destructive NVMe RAID1 member-removal procedure, while the source lacks the authoritative controller workflow, fail-LED matrix and recovery needed to execute safely.
disposition_reason: ED-01 only forbids RAID0 rebuild and does not authorize this destructive RAID1 creation/removal scenario. Parameterization cannot supply the missing supported controller semantics, OEM fail-LED behavior or recovery authority. Locate/raw control is not equivalent to a real degraded member state.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row115 all18 XLSX cells and history2723.
Preserved RAID1 creation, exactly one mapped member removal, real degraded-state evidence and physical fail-LED observation.
Retained the decision because controller-specific destructive semantics and recovery cannot be safely invented; no DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: NVMe RAID1 single-member-removal fail-LED validation pending controller authority
test_case.purpose: Verify one approved disposable NVMe RAID1 member removal creates the documented degraded/fail state and corresponding physical RAID-fail LED.
required_package: Authoritative decision that literal NVMe scope supersedes SAS/SATA taxonomy or separate approved variants
Pinned RAID controller/platform create, initialize, member-removal and degraded-state commands/semantics
OEM fail-LED color/cadence/timing matrix and supported hot-removal procedure
Critical destructive authorization, qualified operator, OOB access, abort limits and separately approved recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not execute until engineering supplies the approved controller lifecycle. Then create and prove healthy the exact disposable NVMe RAID1, have a qualified operator remove exactly one mapped member, capture controller degraded/member state and synchronized physical fail-LED evidence, and leave recovery for separate authorization. Never substitute Locate/raw LED control.
test_case.expected_result: The exact array changes from healthy to the controller-defined degraded state after removal of one intended member, and only the mapped bay shows the OEM-specified fail LED without uncontrolled rebuild or additional fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative controller state, exact member identity and physical fail-LED evidence. A toggled indicator, lsblk output, guessed command or production-array observation cannot pass.
safety_gate: Use only verified disposable non-boot, non-management, non-production members.
Capture healthy membership and ensure no background rebuild before removal.
Remove exactly one mapped member; never force online, clear faults or remove a second member.
Abort on wrong slot, unexpected virtual disk, automatic/uncontrolled rebuild, data/filesystem/controller/thermal/power error or lost recovery; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Engineering scope decision and critical authorization
Exact RAID1 create/initialize output and healthy baseline
Operator/removal timestamp plus physical fail-LED video
Controller degraded/member/rebuild status, OS/BMC/health logs and approved final disposition
test_case.recovery: Preserve the degraded array and all evidence. Do not reinsert, rebuild, force online or clear the event until the storage owner separately approves the exact recovery path; if identity differs, stop and isolate the system.

source_conflict.reason: SAS/SATA grouping versus explicit NVMe RAID1 destructive procedure remains a material device-family conflict requiring project authority.

blocked.reason: Static review is complete, but execution is prohibited pending authoritative destructive workflow and recovery.

pending.owner: Storage/RAID controller, NVMe/backplane and safety owners.
pending.unlock_condition: Approve the authoritative hardware scope, exact controller RAID1 failure semantics, disposable target mapping, fail-LED table and recoverable lifecycle.
